reply: The 7-point score is 3, which meets or exceeds the threshold of 3. The criteria_implied_action is excision due to the score being at or above the threshold. No guideline recommendation is available for NEV; however, for melanoma, the contingent guideline recommends primary excision with a narrow margin (1–3 mm) when melanoma is suspected, as per DOI:10.1016/j.ejca.2024.115153.
